hook.text: It was the band's first record with Barry Stern on drums, and four of its songs got music videos.

facts.label: Players
facts.value: Eric Wagner (vocals), Bruce Franklin (guitars), Rick Wartell (guitars), Ron Holzner (bass), Barry Stern (drums), Jeff Olson (keyboards)

sentences.text: David Bianco and Jimmy Heyson engineered the record, with Brian Jenkins as assistant engineer.
Eric Wagner, Bruce Franklin and Rick Wartell wrote all of the tracks.
The original version was mastered by Greg Fulginiti at Artisan Sound Recorders in Los Angeles.
Hammerheart Records reissued and remastered the album on 27 November 2020, working with Trouble, Inc.
For that 2020 version, Erwin Hermsen remastered it at Toneshed Recording Studio in the Netherlands.
A DVD of the videos came out in 2007 on the band's Trouble, Inc. label.
